problem_keywords: fixing wall wrap to steel studs
use_cases: temporarily holding foil sarking to steel studs with double-sided tape before cladding
sealing seams on vapour-permeable membranes to form an airtight envelope
fastening pliable building membranes with plastic cap nails to prevent blowout in windy conditions
retrieval.rag_summary: Ametalin Accessories encompass the specialised range of tapes, fasteners, and thermal isolation components developed by Ametalin to ensure compliant installation of building membranes. Including double-sided fixing tapes, reinforced foil duct tapes, plastic cap nails, and thermal break strips, these products eliminate thermal bridging, wind displacement, and moisture leakage across steel and timber frames. They ensure residential and commercial wall wraps, roof sarkings, and underfloor foils achieve their designed airtightness, condensation control, and energy ratings.
